title: Funny Crystalistics (Crystals)
description:
This mod adds 10 (maybe more later) fun crystal powers.... Its a great time with friends!


(Also Adds Paintings... shhhhh)
body:
This is Funny Crystalistics, its a mod that adds custom crystal abilities that can be used in seberal ways. This is HEAVILY BASED on BLISS SMP and its powers, as I find them really cool. This mod was made in MCreator if you were wondering.

CRYSTALS
--------
Ice Platform: Spawns a trail of ice that lasts a few seconds 
Lighting: summons lightning around you, hurting any mobs nearby 
Phase: sets you in spectator for a few seconds so you can evade any fight 
Stone: gives you resistance 99 for a few, but makes you really slow 
Flying: gives levitation for a bit, then resistance for the fall 
Substitute: turns you invisable and adds an armor stand in your place
Explosion: Boom...
Nether Warp: warp to nether
Endmention: Teleport to end
Lava Breath: Turns lava around you to air when inside
